title: Surjectivity of the canonical local completion comparison
statement: Let $R$ be a Noetherian commutative ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $S$ a commutative $R$-algebra finite as an $R$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module], and $\mathfrak p$ a prime ideal of $R$. Put $A=R_{\mathfrak p}$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], $\mathfrak m$ its maximal ideal, $C=\varprojlim_n A/\mathfrak m^n$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], $Q=\{\mathfrak q\subset S: \mathfrak q\text{ prime},\ \mathfrak q\cap R=\mathfrak p\}$, and $D_{\mathfrak q}=\varprojlim_n S_{\mathfrak q}/(\mathfrak q S_{\mathfrak q})^n$. Let $\varphi_{\mathfrak q}:A\to S_{\mathfrak q}$ be the canonical localized map. Let $f:C\otimes_R S\to\prod_{\mathfrak q\in Q}D_{\mathfrak q}$ be an $S$-algebra map (tensor product as in [def-weil-module-base-change]). Assume that for every $\mathfrak q\in Q$, $n\geq0$, $a\in C$ and $r\in A$, the equality $a_n=r\bmod\mathfrak m^n$ implies $f(a\otimes1)_{\mathfrak q,n}=\varphi_{\mathfrak q}(r)\bmod(\mathfrak q S_{\mathfrak q})^n$. Then $f$ is surjective.

proof.text: Construct psi_q:B→S_q from the localized base map and the S-algebra structure by the tensor universal property. It sends J into the maximal ideal, so quotient maps at every level and liftRingHom construct g from the completion of B to the local completion product. These constructions and their level equations are proved in Lean.

Apply the localized-algebra interpolation theorem to this explicitly constructed g to obtain surjectivity of g. This carries exactly the quotient product and cofinal-filtration part of the original plan.

Use the explicitly constructed completionFiniteExtensionTensorMap t, which is bijective by the finite-module tensor comparison. Its quotient formula is proved by unfolding its construction. On a tensor a tensor 1, the given hypothesis and the quotient formulas imply f=g∘t by completion extensionality. Both maps agree on 1 tensor s by their S-algebra structure. Tensor induction and multiplicativity prove agreement everywhere. Lift a tuple first through g, then through t, and compose these two equations to obtain its f-preimage.

theorem completion_tensor_localMaps_surjective
    (R : Type u) (S : Type v) [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    [IsNoetherianRing R] [Module.Finite R S] (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime] :
    let A := Localization.AtPrime p
    let m := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A
    let C := AdicCompletion m A
    let Q := p.primesOver S
    let D := fun q : Q ↦
      AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime q.1))
        (Localization.AtPrime q.1)
    letI := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra (R := R) (A := C) (B := S)
    ∀ (f : (C ⊗[R] S) →ₐ[S] (∀ q : Q, D q)),
      (∀ (q : Q) (n : ℕ) (a : C) (r : A),
        evalₐ m n a = Ideal.Quotient.mk (m ^ n) r →
        evalₐ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime q.1)) n
            (f (a ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : S)) q) =
          Ideal.Quotient.mk ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime q.1)) ^ n)
            (Localization.localRingHom p q.1 (algebraMap R S)
              (Ideal.LiesOver.over (P := q.1) (p := p)) r)) →
      Function.Surjective f
